head_commit.message:
Port Arachnaphobia and trace C entries through native Go

Replace the five-int Arachnaphobia entry with full native object/argument pointers and move the remaining flags9 trace wrapper into Go. Preserve both exact C bodies, live cache/argument/update/player reads, five-argument C ABI and the existing typed Go algorithm. The trace wrapper calls the existing Go map service directly and preserves raw pointers, null outputs and signed-DWORD results.

Compare62 sealed original cast cases and16 standalone original trace controls through three entry routes and three foreign placements, with actual default map compositions. All4740 existing protected tests/fixtures remain unchanged. Final normal and highres/cgocheck2/checkptr2 each pass163528 regressions with zero warnings; 769 new native checks and36 existing server checks pass. Full product/runtime/CI qualification follows separately.
